text:
maria_support: Customer reports intermittent 500s and duplicate-side-effects when using our TypeScript SDK behind an API gateway. They say retries appear to replay the original POST even after the client aborted the request.

maria_support: Error snippet from logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate 500 InternalServerError
request_id=ry_abc123
retries=1
client_signal=aborted
```

alex_dev: Which SDK version + node + undici? Any repro steps?

maria_support: SDK v2.3.1, node 20.5, undici 5.14. Customer reuses an AbortController across retries (common pattern in their code). They say behavior started after we rolled 2.3.x.

sam_sre: Do we have gateway logs showing two POSTs with different request IDs? That'd confirm duplicate side-effect.

maria_support: Attached minimal repro logs (stripped): two POSTs 1s apart, second has same body, different request_id, original client printed "aborted" prior to retry.

maria_support: Repro snippet they used: 
```
const ac = new AbortController();
await sdk.post('/v1/generate', { body, signal: ac.signal, retry: { maxRetries: 3 } });
// on timeout they call ac.abort(); // then SDK retry kicks in
```

alex_dev: If they abort the signal but then SDK internally reuses the same signal for the retry, the retry could still be delivered to the server once the SDK creates a fresh request. Need to check our retry implementation with Fetch/undici - signals are not cloneable.

tim_sdk: I can repro locally with v2.3.1. Reusing the AbortController + SDK retry path yields a race where undici re-creates a request while signal is already aborted, causing the SDK to treat it as a local abort but then the retry code issues a new request without replacing the signal. This matches bug #INF-472.

maria_support: Customer is blocked (payment capture duplicated), urgent. Any short-term workaround?

tim_sdk: Workaround 1: don't reuse AbortController between calls — create a fresh one per attempt or pass undefined for signal in retryable calls. Workaround 2: set idempotency key header for POSTs if backend supports it.

alex_dev: Could also set retry:{ maxRetries:0 } server-side per customer to avoid client retries while we patch.

sam_sre: Can we ship a hotfix?

tim_sdk: Preparing patch: fix ensures we create a brand-new AbortSignal for each retry attempt (clone behavior: ignore original.signal on retry). I'll open a PR and cut a v2.3.2 hotfix. PR #2894.

deploy-bot: CI job passed for patch branch (build 6023) :white_check_mark:

tim_sdk: Pushed canary npm tag v2.3.2-canary. maria_support, can you ask customer to test with `@redwood/sdk@2.3.2-canary` and confirm no duplicate POSTs?

maria_support: Will ask. Also capturing escalation notes and suggested mitigations in ticket. :pray: 

alex_dev: Logged followup: add unit tests for AbortController reuse + e2e with undici; add docs note about not reusing signals across calls.

maria_support: Thanks — will update ticket and ping when customer validates.
